#2792 -- "Need to report error when use constant which has offset bigger than
root constant size."
https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/issues/2792

WHAT TO LOOK FOR: every pane compiles, exit 0, with no diagnostic about the
shader. That is the bug -- the reported defect is a diagnostic that is missing,
so there is nothing red to read; the evidence is what the compilers accept.
(Pane messages about "DXIL.dll not found ... will not be signed" or an unused
"-Qembed_debug" argument come from Compiler Explorer's environment and are not
complaints about this shader.)

The root signature reserves ONE 32-bit constant at b0 (num32BitConstants = 1),
the cbuffer bound there declares two floats, and the shader reads the second.
"Buffer Definitions" in the DXC panes shows the cbuffer is twice the size the
root signature reserves:

    float a;   ; Offset:    0
    float b;   ; Offset:    4
    } cb;      ; Offset:    0 Size:     8     <-- 8 bytes; root sig reserves 4

and every pane emits the out-of-bounds load anyway:

    %N = call %dx.types.CBufRet.f32 @dx.op.cbufferLoadLegacy.f32(...)
    %M = extractvalue %dx.types.CBufRet.f32 %N, 1   <-- component 1, i.e. the
                                                       32-bit word past the end

Root-signature-vs-shader validation does run here in DXC: move the root
constants to b1 and it reports "Shader CBV descriptor range ... is not fully
bound in root signature". It checks which registers a root signature covers,
never how many 32-bit constants a root constant block holds -- setting
num32BitConstants to 2 (correct) produces identical output to 1 (out of
bounds), which is what shows the field is never compared against the cbuffer.

Two caveats on reading the panes:

- This is a compute restatement of the issue's pixel shader, so Clang -- whose
  DXIL backend cannot yet lower a shader writing SV_Target -- answers the same
  question on the same input. The pixel original behaves identically and is the
  local evidence; the restatement was checked both ways, and reading only the
  in-range constant makes the symptom go away.
- hlsl_clang_trunk does parse and check root signature syntax (a malformed one
  gives "error: invalid parameter of RootSignature"), but it has no
  root-signature-vs-shader checking at all yet: it also accepts a root
  signature binding b1 while the cbuffer sits at b0, which DXC rejects. Read
  its clean pane as "not implemented there either", not as independent
  confirmation that the shader is fine.

Compiler Explorer runs Release builds, which makes no difference here because
this is a missing diagnostic rather than an assert. Measured locally on a Debug
main build and on all 20 DXC releases from v1.4.1907 to v1.9.2607 -- identical
behaviour throughout.
